curiosity: Why does a water droplet survive for minutes on a scorching pan above 200°C, but vanishes in two seconds on a warm pan?

titles.desktop: Why Liquid Skates on Fire: The Leidenfrost Effect
titles.shorts: Liquid Skates on Fire! The Leidenfrost Secret #Shorts

desktop_mission.mission_sub: Vapor Cushion Thermal Insulation & Frictionless Levitation
desktop_mission.voice_mission: Today we're simulating the Leidenfrost effect, vapor cushion insulation, and film boiling in Kotlin.
math_cards: A micro-layer of vaporized gas insulates the liquid core, dropping heat conduction by over 90%
Expanding vapor pressure creates upward thrust, balancing droplet weight for frictionless gliding
Crossing the Leidenfrost threshold plunges heat flux, extending droplet lifespan by tenfold
desktop_mission.voice_math: The core physics: vapor cushion thermal insulation, hydrodynamic levitation, and the Nukiyama boiling heat flux collapse.

math_steps.note: Quarter-power scaling governs the insulating vapor gap thickness beneath the droplet
math_steps.code:
// 1. Insulating vapor cushion thickness scaling (quarter-power law)
val effectiveDeltaT = max(surfaceTempC - boilingPointC, 1f)
val vaporThicknessUm = 55f * (effectiveDeltaT / 100f).pow(0.25f) * (dropletRadiusMm / 3f).pow(0.25f)
val vaporThicknessM = vaporThicknessUm * 1e-6f
math_steps.sub_desc: Solves for the microscopic insulating steam blanket thickness.

math_steps.badge: EQUATION 2 OF 3 • CONDUCTION HEAT FLUX & LIFETIME
math_steps.formula: q" = k_vapor · (ΔT / δ),  dm/dt = -(q" · A) / h_fg
math_steps.note: Thermal conductivity of vapor is 25x lower than liquid, starving the droplet of boil heat
math_steps.code:
// 2. Vapor barrier heat conduction and droplet phase change rate
val heatFluxWPerM2 = (kv * effectiveDeltaT / max(vaporThicknessM, 1e-6f))
val massEvapRateKgPerS = (heatFluxWPerM2 * dropletBaseArea) / latentHeatOfVaporization
dropletMassKg = max(0f, dropletMassKg - massEvapRateKgPerS * dt)
math_steps.sub_desc: Computes reduced convective heat transfer and extended droplet lifetime.

math_steps.formula: a_x = g · sin(θ) - (μ_eff · g · cos(θ)),  μ_eff ≈ 0.002
math_steps.note: Complete absence of solid-liquid contact eliminates surface friction on tilted substrates
math_steps.code:
// 3. Hydrodynamic gliding down tilted pan with near-zero vapor shear
val tiltRad = tiltDeg * PI.toFloat() / 180f
val frictionCoeff = if (isLeidenfrost) 0.002f else 0.45f
val accelX = (9.81f * sin(tiltRad) - frictionCoeff * 9.81f * cos(tiltRad)) * 1000f
dropletVelX = (dropletVelX + accelX * dt) * 0.998f
math_steps.sub_desc: Integrates acceleration on inclined surfaces with ultra-low vapor shear.

en.title: Leidenfrost Effect
en.teaser: Liquid droplets skate frictionlessly across searing surfaces, hovering on an insulating cushion of their own vapor.

en.hook: Why does a water droplet survive for minutes on a searing pan above 200 degrees, but vanishes in seconds on a warm pan?
en.math: At extreme temperatures, instant vaporization creates an insulating steam cushion, slashing heat transfer and eliminating friction.
en.question: Can we simulate vapor cushion insulation, the Nukiyama boiling curve, and frictionless gliding live in Kotlin Multiplatform?
en.code_tip: We model film boiling heat flux collapse, evaluate vapor thickness scaling, and simulate levitating droplets on Canvas.
en.payoff: The Leidenfrost effect running live in Kotlin.
